system.description:
This ritual grants you a mystical servant of dubious origin. Once your familiar is found, it cannot be changed. It remains in your service even beyond death.

Familiars take the form of small animals or miniature monsters. Regardless of its shape, it possesses enough intelligence to follow simple commands. Your familiar can speak if it possesses a mouth; it knows the languages of its master. You can see through its eyes for up to 10 minutes (1 dungeon action) per day.

Your familiar flees to your pocket at the first sign of danger. When caught in the open, it uses your defense and possesses a hit point total equal to half your own. If your familiar is defeated, it dies on the spot.

You can cast this incantation again to call back your familiar after its death. On a success, it will find its way back in 2d6 weeks; the Judge makes this roll in secret. Each spark you roll reduces its journey by one week.
